_comment: Mutation testing of the engine (docs/benchmarks/mutation.md). A measurement, not a gate: no CI job, hook or workflow runs it.
plugins_comment: Named explicitly: Bun installs each package in isolation, so Stryker's default @stryker-mutator/* glob finds no plugins next to its core.
tsconfigFile_comment: A file that does not exist, which turns off Stryker's tsconfig rewrite. The rewrite needs the TypeScript JS API, which TypeScript 7 does not ship, and only fixes paths that leave the sandbox; the sandbox holds the whole repository, so none do.
